arguments.sql_query:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT de.person_id) AS breast_cancer_patients_receiving_anastrozole
FROM omop.drug_exposure de
JOIN omop.concept_ancestor da
  ON de.drug_concept_id = da.descendant_concept_id
JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co
  ON co.person_id = de.person_id
JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca
  ON co.condition_concept_id = ca.descendant_concept_id
WHERE da.ancestor_concept_id = 1348265
  AND ca.ancestor_concept_id = 4116071;

content.text:
A typical aromatase inhibitor is **anastrozole**.

Using OMOP:
- Drug: `anastrozole` ingredient, concept_id `1348265`
- Breast cancer condition anchor: `Carcinoma of breast`, concept_id `4116071`
- Counted distinct patients with breast cancer who had an anastrozole drug exposure

**Result: 2,182 breast-cancer patients received anastrozole.**
